notes: Reassigned staff counted as present if reassigned_in > 0; formula uses present + replacement as available staff
Approved leave is excluded from absenteeism; only unapproved absences count
Overcapacity preserved when occupied > operational; not capped at 100%
Eligibility requires official_wait_stage_eligible_flag = True AND encounter_wait_eligible_flag = True; negative or null intervals excluded
Valid complaints only; encounter count as approved exposure base
Weighted sum of valid satisfaction scores divided by valid response count; scale handled at preparation layer
